scenes.headline: How an agent memory keeps the prompt cache warm
scenes.sub: TencentDB Agent Memory: four tiers, sorted by how often they change.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tundra! TencentDB Agent Memory is Tencent's open-source memory for coding agents. Its four-tier pyramid hides a clever idea. Let's dig in.

scenes.text: The tiers are sorted by volatility, not abstraction. Only what rarely changes enters the cached system prompt; everything that moves becomes a tool.
scenes.say: The tiers are sorted by volatility, not abstraction. Only what rarely changes goes into the cached system prompt. Everything that moves becomes a tool.

scenes.title: Where each tier reaches the model

steps.say: Point your coding agent at MemoryProxy. It forwards OpenAI and Anthropic requests verbatim, adding memory on the way past.
The persona tier is stable and usually short, so it goes into the system prompt in full.
Scene blocks run to thousands of characters, so only their index goes in: paths, and a one-line summary each.
The raw log and the atomic facts are never injected here. The model searches them itself, through read-only tools.
Why? Anything in the system prompt that changes breaks the provider's prompt cache, and you pay for the whole prefix again.

scenes.title: What a memory search does
scenes.say: When the model does search, the retrieval underneath is real.

items.say: BM25 finds the record with the exact identifier you typed.
Embeddings find the one that means what you meant.
Reciprocal rank fusion merges the two lists, with no calibrated scores needed.
And a guide caps it at three searches a turn. Nothing found? Answer from what you have.

scenes.label: PersonaMem, without and with memory: the repository's one benchmark
scenes.note: no harness, model or seed count published
scenes.say: The one benchmark: PersonaMem rises from forty-eight to seventy-six percent. It's first-party, with no harness published.

scenes.text: The cost of memory isn't storage. It's the prompt prefix you invalidate by updating it.

recap: Stable tiers are injected; volatile ones become tools
BM25 and vectors, merged by rank fusion
Three searches a turn, then answer
scenes.say: To recap: inject what's stable, index what's big, and turn what moves into tools.
